TITLE: OPEN BIBLE
COULD_NOT_ZIP: Could not prepare ZIP on device.
CURRENTLY_THREE: We currently have three languages in the online project, but only English (UK) is available in this app.
PERPETUAL_FREEDOM: Everyone is granted Perpetual Freedom—the right to adapt and share this Open Translation Bible (OTB). You may copy, modify and distribute the text without restriction. It is open-source—the first Bible of its kind.
BECOME_BIG_BUSINESS: Before the Open Bible (OTB) was released in July 2025, english Bibles were either proprietary translations or unprotected public-domain texts. In practice, the Bible on your shelf was less accessible than it seemed. Using a modern English translation for study, teaching, digital projects or creative works often meant facing restrictive copyrights.
LIMITATION_CREATE: These limitations are removed with an open-source Bible. You may share, adapt and distribute this text in any meaningful way. Open source can resemble the public domain at first glance, but it differs in one crucial respect: its licence. Public-domain works have no licence, so derivatives can be re-released under restrictive terms; open-source licences preserve your freedoms and require derivatives to remain free.
OPEN_BIBLE_UNIQUE: The world's first Open Source Bible

BOOKMARKS_HELP: Bookmarks help you jump back to places quickly. Long-press a verse in the Read tab, choose "Bookmark", and pick a colour.
